name: list_team_flags
description:
Retrieve all feature flags for a team across all projects. The list can be filtered by state and supports pagination.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v1/teams/{teamId}/feature-flags/flags --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

kind.description: The kind of flags to retrieve.

limit.description: Maximum number of flags to return.

search.description: Search flags by their slug or description. Case-insensitive.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

state.description: The state of the flags to retrieve. Defaults to `active`.

tags.description: Filter flags by tag. Repeat the parameter for multiple tags (all must match).

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.

withMetadata.description: Deprecated. Whether to include creator metadata in each flag in the response. Resolve creator identity client-side (e.g. via the team members endpoint) instead; this parameter will be removed in a future release.
